execution: decide at close of day t, fill at open of day t+1, long-only, no leverage, fractional units, sleeve = one ticker with own capital, USD treated as EUR-equivalent
interpretations: Pivot: low (high) strictly below (above) the 5 bars on each side, usable only 5 bars after it formed.
Trade normalisation: a trade return times 1.000 EUR is the 'expectancy in EUR on 1.000 EUR' (trades do not compound).
W3 decides on Friday close (Sunday close for crypto) and fills at the next open; a week with a holiday Friday has no decision.
W3 ranks inside the peer group (segment, crypto, metals); 'stocks_all' pools the segment sleeves, it does not re-rank.
W4 zone qualification, touch definition and expiry, and W6/W7 completions are written in each contender's rules and are fixed.
W6 half exit is modelled as a real partial sale at the target (half of the units); the rest is trailed under the prior 10-bar low.
ATR14 is the simple mean of the true range over 14 bars.
If stop and target are touched in one bar the stop is assumed first. Time exits fill at the next open.
All tickers use the common end 2026-10-05 (crypto and metals too) so groups are comparable.
Sharpe uses sqrt(252) for every group, including crypto (which trades every calendar day).
label: pre-registered contender
rules: Weekly bias not bearish: week-to-date close > weekly SMA10 (9 completed weeks plus the current close).
Daily price in discount: the close of the sweep bar is below 50 percent of the range between the latest confirmed swing low and swing high.
Liquidity sweep in the last 5 bars: low through one of the last 3 confirmed swing lows and close back above it.
Trigger: close above the last confirmed lower high (first such close); buy at the next open.

Stop = sweep low - 0.5 ATR14. Target = the latest swing high if above the close, else the nearest confirmed swing high above. Sell half at the target, trail the rest under the prior 10-bar low. Time exit after 20 bars.
